# `aitbc edge transfer`

Transfer edge tokens to another address with an optional note via the local edge API.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge transfer [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--to-address` | text | — | yes | Destination address. |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Amount of AIT. |
| `--note` | text | — | no | Transfer note |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge transfer --to-address <to_address> --amount <amount>
```
